title: 冬の健康・かぜ予防 絵本風
subject_en: Winter health and cold-prevention scenes for school and nursery newsletters, each a separate small scene with ONE friendly child (about 3.5-head proportion, round face, simple clothes) or a single object. Picture-book style with soft rounded closed outlines in warm brown-grey, clearly darker than the fill; light parts (masks, tissue, snow, milk) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: 手洗い、うがい、マスク、早寝早起き、あたたかい服。保健だよりや園のおたより、教室の掲示に使える、冬の健康のイラスト12点。絵本のようなやさしいタッチ。

a child gargling with a cup, head tilted back

a child opening a window with fresh air swirls
a digital thermometer with a blank display
